title: Warm Rendered Norwegian Lamb Hash
description: A traditional Norwegian dish made with lamb, chives, and render fat, this hash is a hearty and indulgent meal, perfect for a cold winter morning. It is also Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lamb cubes with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Heat the render fat in a large oven-safe skillet over medium high heat.
Add the lamb cubes to the skillet and sear until they are browned on all sides.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the chopped chives.
Serve the lamb hash hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
